Digital Escape Room / Puzzle Lock Builder

Chain QR-code puzzle stations into an escape room — each correct answer unlocks the next clue, right in the student's browser — nothing leaves your device

Stations (the puzzle chain)
Each station's accepted answer unlocks the next one. Matching ignores case and extra spaces. Leave "Next station" on Auto for a straight linear chain, or point it anywhere for a branching path.
Player link
This is the same link/QR code for every station — what changes is each student's own saved progress. Project it, or print a station-specific code below.
Print layout
For physical rotations where several teams start at different stations at once: turns each station's own code into its own entry point, so a team that starts by scanning Station 4 begins the chain right there instead of being told to go find Station 1 first. Leave off if everyone starts together at Station 1.
Baked into the player link/QR code. Since there's no shared server clock, each device's countdown starts the moment that student first opens their own link, not a synced room-wide start — it counts down live, then shows “Time’s up!” without blocking their progress.
Each printed code is stamped for its own station, so scanning Station 3's code before solving Station 1 or 2 tells the player to go find those first. The answer key prints separately — keep it with you, not with the students.

Station QR code preview

Add at least one station with a clue and an accepted answer to see a preview.

Answer key (for you)
Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded, and no student data leaves this device. The full answer key travels inside the player link/QR data itself, the same way the QR Scavenger Hunt Builder's answer key is printable — this is a classroom convenience tool, not a security system.
